decisions.change: Swap the vehicles on 6 pairs of trips that start within half an hour of each other, beginning with the 20-seat bus on route 901 at 16:59 and the 64-seat bus on route 904 at 16:52.
decisions.cost_note: No extra bus and no extra driver. About 190.5 km of empty running. Not checked here: the blocks, the depots, and whether the bigger bus fits every stop and turn on the other route. A planner decides.

effect.assumption: the same passengers board at the same times and only the vehicles change. A pair is proposed only if each bus can reach the other trip's first stop in time at 25 km/h from where its trip before ended; a bus with no trip before comes from the depot, and that run is not in these records

decisions.title: Put the bigger bus where the passengers are
decisions.why: Route 901 carried 27 passengers on a bus with 20 seats while a 64-seat bus on route 904 carried at most 11 in the same hour.

decisions.change: After 20:00, make 14 stops on route K900 request stops: the bus calls there when a passenger asks from the stop or from the bus.
decisions.cost_note: A way to ask at each stop: a button, or a tap in the app. Nobody loses a stop: the bus calls whenever it is asked.

effect.assumption: the bus calls at these stops only when a passenger asks, and on the day nobody boarded or alighted on these visits

evidence.label: Of those, visits where nobody boarded and nobody alighted
Middle time a bus spent at such a visit

decisions.title: Stop only when someone is there
decisions.why: At 14 stops on route K900, nobody boarded or alighted on 89 of 94 visits after 20:00. That is one day: RTA's own route planning already looks for little-used stops, and this adds the hours in which it holds. The time each such call costs is not in these records, so no time saved is claimed.

decisions.change: Offer Khutwa points to passengers at this stop who take a bus with room: one a little earlier or later, or one on another route a short walk away.
decisions.cost_note: Points for each passenger who shifts. Nobody is charged more, and an offer to walk is never made to someone who has said they cannot. Khutwa is this prototype's name for the points. RTA's nol Plus already gives points for spending; what is added here is offering them only where the day shows a gap.

effect.assumption: 8 in 100 passengers who get the offer take it. Trials in San Francisco and Singapore found 7 to 11 in 100. A planner can move this number.

decisions.title: Reward the passenger who takes the emptier bus
decisions.why: The 17:17 bus on route 901 left this stop with 25 passengers and 20 seats, and a bus with room was close in time or place.
